# orion workspace

List, create, rename, archive, restore, and choose workspaces

```sh
orion workspace <command> [options]
```

## orion workspace list

List workspaces and mark the active one

```sh
orion workspace list [options]
```

| Argument     | Description                      |
| ------------ | -------------------------------- |
| `--archived` | List archived workspaces instead |
| `--json`     | Print JSON                       |

## orion workspace create

Create a workspace with its own data folder

```sh
orion workspace create [name] [options]
```

| Argument          | Description                                        |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `[name]`          | Workspace name. Omit it to derive one from --label |
| `--label <value>` | Display label                                      |

## orion workspace rename

Change a workspace's display label

```sh
orion workspace rename [name] [label] [options]
```

| Argument  | Description       |
| --------- | ----------------- |
| `[name]`  | Workspace name    |
| `[label]` | New display label |

## orion workspace set

Set a canvas's cover or background

```sh
orion workspace set [options]
```

| Argument               | Description                                                                    |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--cover <value>`      | Image asset id for the cover, from orion media insert --json (empty to clear)  |
| `--background <value>` | Color, color token such as card.background, or image asset id (empty to clear) |
| `--header <value>`     | Markdown with layout HTML shown over the top of the canvas (empty to clear)    |

## orion workspace archive

Archive a workspace. Its data stays in place, and restore brings it back

```sh
orion workspace archive [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Description    |
| -------- | -------------- |
| `[name]` | Workspace name |

## orion workspace restore

Restore an archived workspace with its data

```sh
orion workspace restore [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Description             |
| -------- | ----------------------- |
| `[name]` | Archived workspace name |

## orion workspace use

Make a workspace the active one

```sh
orion workspace use [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Description    |
| -------- | -------------- |
| `[name]` | Workspace name |

## orion workspace current

Print the active workspace

```sh
orion workspace current [options]
```
